full_judgment:
Md Abdur Rashid J: Plaintiff presented the above appeal against the decree dated 14-7-98 passed by the First Court of Subordinate Judge at Narayanganj in Title Suit No. 70 of 1995, which rejected the plaint of the suit. 

 In the result the appeal is dismissed with cost. Impugned decree rejecting the plaint is hereby affirmed. Send down the record at once.
